description: Boards and nominations: approve, hide or answer a post; Ideas: set its status, category, reply or pin Body (any of): status shown (approve or show again), hidden, answered (Q&A) or pending; stage review, planned, doing, done, not or '' (Ideas); label (a category id); reply (≤500 chars, '' removes it); pinned. Organizers never edit what people wrote. On a nomination these work only while suggestions are open (409 suggestions_closed after). Needs the organizer key.
